description: This header file defines types, function prototypes, and macros related to collecting and executing functions across worker threads in the lighttpd server project. It provides mechanisms to start collection processes, callback functions, and control functionalities such as breaking collection.

methods.name: li_collect_start
methods.description: Starts a collection process by executing a callback function in each worker context, returning a liCollectInfo pointer to manage the process.

methods.name: li_collect_start_global
methods.description: Initiates a global collection process using the main worker of the server, calling the provided callback once per worker context.

methods.name: li_collect_break
methods.description: Stops an ongoing collection process prematurely, indicating that the callback should treat the operation as incomplete.
